d23_composite.definition: ligand pLDDT >= t_plddt AND (site_centroid_dist <= t_centroid OR site_recall >= t_recall), in >= 2 of 3 seeds

caveats: Ligand pLDDT is unreliable for single-metal ligands: on the metal subset the cognate ion scores LOWER than the site-ablated variant, because AF3 gives a lone ion poor per-atom confidence wherever it puts it. Read the per-class AUCs, not the pooled number, and do not call a metal-site case on pLDDT.
Geometry readouts (centroid distance, site recall) separate the metal class cleanly where pLDDT and PAE do not -- further support for the D23 concordance rule requiring pLDDT AND a geometry readout.
Panel decoys are hard in-class near-misses, so these AUCs are a lower bound relative to the caffeine-style decoys in docs/COFOLD.md Sec.4.3.
calibration.decoy_caveat: 21 of 48 panel decoys exceed ECFP4 Tanimoto 0.4 to their cognate (two at 1.0), so some negatives are real binders. This biases sensitivity and AUC DOWN and makes specificity 0.96 a lower bound. Not retuned; see docs/COFOLD_CONTROLS.md Sec.7.

apo_pool._note: site recall is continuous (never thresholded at 0.8); on the four co-folding positive controls a true positive reached only 0.44-1.00
